I created these interactive visualizations in R to explore the organization, evidence relationships, and qualitative descriptors of the ethnographic fire-use dataset. Select a preview to open the full interactive visualization.

:::: {.visualization-grid}

::: {.visualization-card}

## Evidence Traceability Circle Pack

[![](images/visualizations/circlepack-preview.png){.visualization-preview .circlepack-thumbnail fig-alt="Preview of the interactive evidence traceability circle pack"}](viz-circlepack.qmd)

Explore the connections among comparative fire classes, canonical fire uses, provisional fire-use entries, and supporting atomic claims. Click a class or use to zoom into its records, and hover over a circle to view its details.

[Explore the circle pack](viz-circlepack.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

:::

::: {.visualization-card}

## Comparative Class and Ontology Heatmap

[![](images/visualizations/comparative-ontology-preview.png){.visualization-preview fig-alt="Preview of the interactive comparative fire class and ontology heatmap"}](viz-ontology-heatmap.qmd)

Compare how canonical fire uses are associated with comparative fire classes and ontology terms. Switch between primary class assignments and combined primary and secondary associations, and hover over cells to inspect the linked uses.

[Explore the ontology heatmap](viz-ontology-heatmap.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

:::

::: {.visualization-card}

## Spatial-Form Treemap

[![](images/visualizations/spatial-form-preview.png){.visualization-preview fig-alt="Preview of the interactive canonical fire-use spatial-form treemap"}](viz-spatial-treemap.qmd)

Explore canonical fire uses grouped by spatial form, including camp and settlement areas, mobility corridors, and wetland margins. Click a spatial-form group to focus on its uses, and hover over a tile to read more.

[Explore the spatial-form treemap](viz-spatial-treemap.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

:::

::: {.visualization-card}

## Timing and Spatial-Form Heatmap

[![](images/visualizations/timing-spatial-preview.png){.visualization-preview fig-alt="Preview of the interactive timing category and spatial-form heatmap"}](viz-timing-spatial.qmd)

Explore the relationships between timing categories and the spatial forms of canonical fire uses. The heatmap groups timing into season-specific, multi-season, and other or unspecified categories. Hover over a cell to inspect the linked uses.

[Explore the timing heatmap](viz-timing-spatial.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

:::
